description: This Java class, IndexFactory, provides static factory methods to create Index instances for MongoDB collections. It includes methods for default, custom, and expiration indexes, handling index properties such as uniqueness, background building, and expiration settings.

classes.name: IndexFactory
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods to create Index objects for MongoDB.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Index with default ascending fields, optionally unique and sparse.

methods.name: newInstanceWithCustomKeys
methods.description: Creates a new Index with specified custom keys, optionally unique and sparse.

methods.name: newExpirationIndex
methods.description: Creates a TTL index for automatic deletion based on a timestamp field.
